The specified power consumption and range values are the official figures obtained from tests under standardised EU test conditions in accordance with

*Maximum power determined in accordance with UN-GTR.21. The maximum power is available at the highest possible battery state of charge and with an

**Acceleration: 0-100 km/h determined with the declared maximum power. The maximum power is available at the highest possible battery state of
